sentences.zh: 第二天，冯·克莱斯特将军调集了1000架飞机对法军阵地进行了狂轰滥炸。

sentences.en: For the French, who, of course, have not been through the experience of the war in Poland, this is a colossal shock.
sentences.zh: 对于没有经历过波兰战役洗礼的法国人来说，这简直是一个巨大的震撼。

sentences.en: It's the first time they've come under air attack.
sentences.zh: 这是他们第一次遭到空袭。

sentences.en: And there are all these stories about their troops sort of cowering in their trenches, sobbing, traumatized, their morale ripped to pieces.
sentences.zh: 有各种各样的报道说他们的部队蜷缩在战壕里瑟瑟发抖、痛哭流涕、受到严重创伤，士气彻底崩溃。

sentences.en: And so by the evening of the 13th, so remember, we're just three or four days into the invasion, the Germans are already crossing the river on rubber dinghies.
sentences.zh: 因此，到13日傍晚——记住，我们才刚刚开战三四天——德国人就已经乘着橡皮艇开始渡河了。

sentences.en: They're putting together pontoon bridges.
sentences.zh: 他们在架设浮桥。

sentences.en: The panzers are getting across.
sentences.zh: 装甲部队正在过河。

sentences.en: They're still quite vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然相当脆弱。

sentences.en: You know, they're still vulnerable to a counterattack.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们面对反击时依然不堪一击。

sentences.en: But the amazing thing, the French are still so complacent.
sentences.zh: 但神奇的是，法军依然如此盲目自满。

sentences.en: The commander of their second army was General Charles Untiguer.
sentences.zh: 他们第二集团军的司令是夏尔·亨蒂热将军。

sentences.en: And General Untiguer is told the Germans are getting across the river Meuse.
sentences.zh: 安蒂盖尔将军得知德军正在渡过默兹河。

sentences.en: And he says, brilliant, all the more prisoners for us.
sentences.zh: 他说，太棒了，这样我们就有更多的俘虏了。

sentences.en: And presumably, General Gamelin is emulating General Joffre and just sitting around having huge lunches and munching on chickens and things.
sentences.zh: 想必甘末郎将军当时在效仿霞飞将军，只是坐在那里吃着丰盛的午餐，嚼着鸡肉之类的东西。

sentences.en: I think there is an element of that.
sentences.zh: 我想确实有这方面的因素。

sentences.en: We'll have some amusing French military action of this kind.
sentences.zh: 我们将看到一些这种好笑的法国军事行动。

sentences.en: A bit with an omelette, which is good fun.
sentences.zh: 还有一个关于煎蛋的插曲，挺有意思的。

sentences.en: So the next couple of days, things go from bad to worse for the French.
sentences.zh: 所以在接下来的几天里，对法国人来说情况急转直下。

sentences.en: They finally decide to launch a counterattack on the Meuse, but it's half-hearted.
sentences.zh: 他们终于决定对默兹河发动反击，但只是敷衍了事。

sentences.en: They don't dislodge the Germans.
sentences.zh: 他们没能击退德军。

sentences.en: They take very heavy losses.
sentences.zh: 他们蒙受了惨重的损失。

sentences.en: And unlike in 1914, their nerve begins to break quite early on.
sentences.zh: 而且与1914年不同，他们的意志很早就开始崩溃了。

sentences.en: So that night, the 14th, there were reports of French troops streaming westwards in a panic, shouting, we've lost, we've been betrayed, and so on.
sentences.zh: 所以在14号那天晚上，有报告称法军士兵在恐慌中向西溃逃，大喊着我们输了，我们被出卖了，诸如此类的话。

sentences.en: And at their headquarters, their commanders are just completely stunned.
sentences.zh: 在他们的指挥部里，指挥官们彻底惊呆了。

sentences.en: They didn't expect the Germans to come through the Ardennes.
sentences.zh: 他们没想到德军会穿过阿登森林。

sentences.en: They didn't expect them to come in such speed or in such numbers.
sentences.zh: 他们没想到德军的速度会这么快，人数会这么多。

sentences.en: They didn't expect them to get across the River Meuse.
sentences.zh: 他们没想到德军能渡过默兹河。

sentences.en: And now they make another catastrophic mistake.
sentences.zh: 而现在他们又犯了一个灾难性的错误。

sentences.en: They think, now the Germans have got across the Meuse, they will head towards Paris.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，既然德军已经渡过了默兹河，就会直奔巴黎而去。

sentences.en: But they won't.
sentences.zh: 但并没有。

sentences.en: They're going to turn sharp right at this point, turn north, and race for the channel.
sentences.zh: 他们将在这一点急转右，向北转向，直奔英吉利海峡。

sentences.en: This is the sickle-cut element of the plan, which will leave the Allied armies trapped.
sentences.zh: 这就是计划中镰刀收割的部分，这将使盟军陷入合围。

sentences.en: And what is worse?
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是什么？

sentences.en: As the French and the British are trying to react, Eastern France has descended into complete chaos, because remembering what happened in the First World War,
sentences.zh: 正当法军和英军试图做出反应时，法国东部已经陷入了彻底的混乱，因为回想起第一次世界大战中的经历，

sentences.en: and having read the reports of what happened in Poland, millions, literally millions of civilians say, God, I've got to get out of here.
sentences.zh: 又读到关于波兰遭遇的报道，数百万，简直是数百万的平民说，天哪，我得离开这里。

sentences.en: And they take to the streets.
sentences.zh: 于是他们涌上街头。

sentences.en: So by this point, we're feeling it's kind of mid-May 1940, there were probably about 8 million people on the roads of France with their possessions, with wagons, with bicycles,
sentences.zh: 所以到这个时候，大概是1940年5月中旬，法国的道路上可能大约有800万带着他们的财产、大车、自行车的人，

sentences.en: with livestock, you know, crying babies, all of that.
sentences.zh: 带着牲畜，你知道的，还有婴儿的哭声，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And that makes it impossible for the French to move their armies around.
sentences.zh: 这使得法军根本无法调动军队。

sentences.en: You know, their communications networks are kind of breaking down, all of this.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们的通信网络正在崩溃，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And then the Stukas start dive-bombing the crowds of refugees, so more terror.
sentences.zh: 然后斯图卡轰炸机开始对难民人群进行俯冲轰炸，带来更多恐惧。

sentences.en: Total carnage.
sentences.zh: 简直是一场大屠杀。

sentences.en: You know, a sense that these are just implacable opponents who can't be defeated.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，人们觉得这些对手冷酷无情，根本无法战胜。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Now, remember how quickly this has happened.
sentences.zh: 现在，想想这一切发生得有多快。

sentences.en: The invasion began in the early hours of the 10th of May.
sentences.zh: 入侵开始于5月10日的凌晨。

sentences.en: On the 15th of May, so five days later, at 7.30 in the morning, Winston Churchill, who's only been Prime Minister for five days,
sentences.zh: 在5月15日，也就是五天后，早上7点30分，刚当了五天首相的温斯顿·丘吉尔，

sentences.en: is woken up at home by a phone call from Paul Raynaud.
sentences.zh: 在家里被保罗·雷诺的一通电话吵醒。

sentences.en: And Raynaud speaks to him in English.
sentences.zh: 雷诺用英语对他说。

sentences.en: And Raynaud says, we have been defeated.
sentences.zh: 雷诺说，我们被击败了。

sentences.en: And Churchill doesn't say anything.
sentences.zh: 丘吉尔什么也没说。

sentences.en: And Raynaud says again, we are beaten.
sentences.zh: 雷诺又说了一遍，我们被打败了。

sentences.en: We have lost the battle.
sentences.zh: 我们输了这场战役。

sentences.en: Churchill, surely it can't have happened so soon.
sentences.zh: 丘吉尔心想，事情怎么可能这么快就发生了。

sentences.en: But he replied, the front is broken near Sedan.
sentences.zh: 但他回答说，色当附近的防线被突破了。

sentences.en: Sedan is exactly where they'd lost the Franco-Prussian War in 1870.
sentences.zh: 色当正是他们在1870年普法战争中战败的地方。

sentences.en: So the next afternoon, the 16th, Churchill flies to Paris.
sentences.zh: 所以在第二天下午，即16号，丘吉尔飞往巴黎。

sentences.en: And he is shocked when he gets there.
sentences.zh: 当他到达时，他震惊了。

sentences.en: They are burning their archives already.
sentences.zh: 他们已经在烧毁档案了。

sentences.en: They are preparing to evacuate the city.
sentences.zh: 他们正准备撤离这座城市。

sentences.en: Utter dejection was written on every face.
sentences.zh: 每张脸上都写满了彻底的沮丧。

sentences.en: And General Gamelin is there.
sentences.zh: 甘末郎将军也在那里。

sentences.en: Gamelin says, not only have we taken this defeat at Sedan, but we have actually fallen back a further 60 kilometers.
sentences.zh: 甘末郎说，我们不仅在色当吃了败仗，实际上还往后退了整整60公里。

sentences.en: The Germans have come 60 kilometers since we last spoke.
sentences.zh: 自从我们上次通话以来，德军已经推进了60公里。

sentences.en: Churchill says this very famous exchange.
sentences.zh: 丘吉尔说出了这段非常著名的对话。

sentences.en: Where is your strategic reserve?
sentences.zh: 你们的战略预备队在哪里？

sentences.en: And Gamelin says, Ucune.
sentences.zh: 甘末郎说，没有。

sentences.en: There isn't any.
sentences.zh: 根本没有。

sentences.en: Churchill, why don't you counterattack?
sentences.zh: 丘吉尔问，你们为什么不反击？

sentences.en: And then Gamelin gives a hopeless shrug of the shoulders and says to him, inferiority of numbers, inferiority of equipment, inferiority of method.
sentences.zh: 然后甘末郎绝望地耸了耸肩膀对他说，数量处于劣势，装备处于劣势，方法处于劣势。

sentences.en: Gamelin's clearly got to go.
sentences.zh: 甘末郎显然得下台了。

sentences.en: I mean, the third of those is definitely right.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这三点里的最后一点绝对是对的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But the first two at the beginning of the war were not right.
sentences.zh: 但战争刚开始时前两点并不对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So three days later on the 19th, Reno sacked Gamelin and he replaced him with General Végon, Maxime Végon, who is a veteran of the First World War,
sentences.zh: 所以在三天后的19号，雷诺撤换了甘末郎，由韦刚将军接替他，也就是马克西姆·韦刚，他是一位一战老兵，

sentences.en: who was 73 and who has been retired for the last five years.
sentences.zh: 当时73岁，已经退休五年了。

sentences.en: Does he, by any chance, have emphysema?
sentences.zh: 他该不会碰巧有肺气肿吧？

sentences.en: It's not the First World War anymore, so maybe not.
sentences.zh: 这已经不是第一次世界大战了，所以也许没有吧。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Végon, you know, he's got all these schemes for a great counterattack, a French counterattack.
sentences.zh: 韦刚，你知道的，他有一整套关于伟大反击、法国反击的计划。

sentences.en: But by now, I think the Allies are in such chaos that any counterattack is going to be very, very difficult.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，我认为盟军已经一片混乱，任何反击都将变得非常非常困难。

sentences.en: The Germans, meanwhile, are rolling on.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，德军势如破竹。

sentences.en: They cannot believe how well this is going.
sentences.zh: 他们简直不敢相信进展会这么顺利。

sentences.en: I mean, even in their wildest dreams, Manstein and Guderian could not have imagined the Allies would fall apart so quickly.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，即使在他们最大胆的梦想中，曼施坦因和古德里安也绝不会想到盟军会溃败得如此之快。

sentences.en: And a famous name in command of one of the panzer divisions, Erwin Rommel.
sentences.zh: 而指挥其中一个装甲师的则是一个著名的名字，埃尔温·隆美尔。

sentences.en: Yeah, Erwin Rommel.
sentences.zh: 是的，埃尔温·隆美尔。

sentences.en: Who will be featuring in due course later on in this story.
sentences.zh: 他在本故事的后续发展中将会崭露头角。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So on the night of the 19th, you began, Tom, this episode with Churchill broadcasting for the first time to the British people after nine days as prime minister.
sentences.zh: 所以在19号的晚上，汤姆，你用丘吉尔在就任首相9天后首次向英国人民发表广播讲话，开启了这一集。

sentences.en: That night, the first panzers reached the mouth of the River Somme on the Channel.
sentences.zh: 就在那天晚上，第一批装甲部队到达了英吉利海峡的索姆河口。

sentences.en: And by the following night, they'd established themselves on the Channel coast properly.
sentences.zh: 到第二天晚上，他们已经在海峡海岸站稳了脚跟。

sentences.en: So at this point, the sickle cut has been carried off.
sentences.zh: 所以此时此刻，镰刀收割计划已经完成。

sentences.en: The entire Allied force in Belgium, that's three French armies.
sentences.zh: 驻扎在比利时的整支盟军部队，那是三个法国集团军。

sentences.en: It's the shattered remains of the Belgian army and the entire British expeditionary force.
sentences.zh: 还有比利时军队支离破碎的残余以及整个英国远征军。

sentences.en: They are all encircled and surrounded, trapped against the sea in this shrinking pocket.
sentences.zh: 他们全被包围了，困在这个日渐缩小的包围圈里，紧贴着大海。

sentences.en: And now, you know, if the French and British commanders were in a bit of a state before, they were in an absolute world-class funk.
sentences.zh: 而现在，你知道的，如果说法国和英国的指挥官之前还有点不知所措的话，那他们现在简直是陷入了极度的恐慌。

sentences.en: It's the word.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个词。

sentences.en: Yeah, it is the word.
sentences.zh: 是的，就是这个词。

sentences.en: The French commander in Belgium is General Gaston-Henri Bilotte.
sentences.zh: 驻比利时的法军指挥官是加斯通-亨利·比洛特将军。

sentences.en: And when he was told, you need to coordinate the Allied response to all this, he burst into tears, which I don't think is ever a good sign in your commanding officer.
sentences.zh: 当有人告诉他，你需要协调盟军对这一切的反应时，他竟然放声大哭，我认为这在你的指挥官身上绝不是什么好兆头。

sentences.en: That's not what you want.
sentences.zh: 这可不是你希望看到的。

sentences.en: On the 20th of May, so that's the day the Allies are definitively cut off, the British sent the chief of their Imperial General Staffs, Edmund Ironside, to Lens.
sentences.zh: 在5月20日，也就是盟军被彻底切断的那天，英国人派出了他们的帝国总参谋长埃德蒙·艾恩赛德前往朗斯。

sentences.en: That is a great name.
sentences.zh: 这个名字真棒。

sentences.en: Yeah, you've got to be called that.
sentences.zh: 是的，你得叫这个名字。

sentences.en: Good for him.
sentences.zh: 真不错。

sentences.en: So General Ironside is sent to Lens to see Bilotte to find out what's going on.
sentences.zh: 于是艾恩赛德将军被派往朗斯见比洛特，以弄清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: And Ironside said later,
sentences.zh: 艾恩赛德后来这样说道，

sentences.en: So the next day, I promised you an omelette.
sentences.zh: 所以在第二天，我答应过你们一个煎蛋。

sentences.en: The next day is the 21st of May.
sentences.zh: 第二天就是5月21日。

sentences.en: General Végon, a new French supreme commander, decided to visit Bilotte personally to steady his nerve.
sentences.zh: 新任法军总司令韦刚将军决定亲自拜访比洛特以稳定他的军心。

sentences.en: And he flew to a place called Bethune on the Franco-Belgian border.
sentences.zh: 他乘飞机来到了法比边境一个叫贝蒂讷的地方。

sentences.en: Végon got there.
sentences.zh: 韦刚到达那里时。

sentences.en: He finds the airfield completely deserted.
sentences.zh: 他发现机场空无一人。

sentences.en: There's just a single soldier.
sentences.zh: 只有一个孤零零的士兵。

sentences.en: And Végon has to persuade the soldier to give him a lift to the local post office.
sentences.zh: 韦刚不得不说服这个士兵捎他一程去当地的邮局。

sentences.en: And there, he finally managed to ring Bilotte and said,
sentences.zh: 在那里，他终于设法给比洛特打了电话，说道，

sentences.en: Send a car.
sentences.zh: 派辆车来。

sentences.en: Like, I'm General Végon.
sentences.zh: 就像，我是韦刚将军。

sentences.en: I'm the supreme commander.
sentences.zh: 我是总司令。

sentences.en: Send a car and get me.
sentences.zh: 派辆车来接我。

sentences.en: A car arrived.
sentences.zh: 一辆车到了。

sentences.en: Végon got in the car and he said, I need lunch.
sentences.zh: 韦刚上了车，说道，我要吃午饭。

sentences.en: Like, let's go and have omelettes.
sentences.zh: 就像，我们去吃煎蛋吧。

sentences.en: He went for an omelette.
sentences.zh: 他去吃煎蛋了。

sentences.en: Then he went and met Bilotte at Ypres Town Hall.
sentences.zh: 然后他去伊珀尔市政厅会见了比洛特。

sentences.en: I mean, talk about a place with a lot of history.
sentences.zh: 我是说，真是一个充满历史底蕴的地方。

sentences.en: And Végon said,
sentences.zh: 韦刚说，

sentences.en: Come on, we've got a counterattack.
sentences.zh: 来吧，我们要发动反击。

sentences.en: Like, we've got to break out, counterattack, whatever.
sentences.zh: 就像，我们得突围，反击，随便什么都行。

sentences.en: Bilotte said, fine.
sentences.zh: 比洛特说，好的。

sentences.en: Bilotte drove off.
sentences.zh: 比洛特开车走了。

sentences.en: His car immediately got involved in a massive car crash.
sentences.zh: 他的车立刻卷入了一场严重的车祸。

sentences.en: Bilotte was badly injured, fell into a coma.
sentences.zh: 比洛特重伤，陷入昏迷。

sentences.en: Two days later, he died.
sentences.zh: 两天后，他去世了。

sentences.en: And that was the end of him.
sentences.zh: 他的故事就这样结束了。

sentences.en: Do you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: The British Expeditionary Forces Chief of Staff, Sir Henry Pownall, he mourned General Bilotte.
sentences.zh: 英国远征军参谋长亨利·庞厄尔爵士，他居然在哀悼比洛特将军。

sentences.en: What did he say?
sentences.zh: 他是怎么说的？

sentences.en: He said, frankly, he's no loss.
sentences.zh: 他说，坦白讲，他的死算不上什么损失。

sentences.en: I mean, it's harsh, but it's not inaccurate.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这话很苛刻，但并非不准确。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So Hitler's attack has been unfolding now less than two weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以希特勒的进攻展开至今还不到两周。

sentences.en: Insane.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: So actually, it's going better than Hitler had said.
sentences.zh: 实际上，进展比希特勒自己预想的还要好。

sentences.en: Than even Hitler had said.
sentences.zh: 比希特勒自己说过的话还要好。

sentences.en: Because he'd prophesied it would take six weeks, right?
sentences.zh: 因为他曾预测这需要六周时间，对吧？

sentences.en: And already by two weeks, it's clear he's won.
sentences.zh: 而仅仅两周，他就已经赢了，这很明显。

sentences.en: He's been going on for like 11 days or something.
sentences.zh: 战争才进行大约11天左右。

sentences.en: And it's pretty clear that the Allies have collapsed.
sentences.zh: 很明显盟军已经崩溃了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: The amazing thing.
sentences.zh: 最神奇的是。

sentences.en: I mean, he's this man who has gambled, gambled again and again.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这个人一直在豪赌，一次又一次地豪赌。

sentences.en: Each one bigger and more ambitious and more reckless than the laSt.
sentences.zh: 每一次都比上一次更大胆、更有野心、更冒险。

sentences.en: And this one is going to work out better than any of them.
sentences.zh: 而这一次的结果将比以往任何一次都要好。

sentences.en: The Allies have completely fallen apart.
sentences.zh: 盟军已经彻底瓦解了。

sentences.en: Their commanders aren't speaking to each other.
sentences.zh: 他们的指挥官甚至互不沟通。

sentences.en: Reynaud and his ministers are preparing to flee Paris.
sentences.zh: 雷诺和他的大臣们正准备逃离巴黎。

sentences.en: Surely France is beaten.
sentences.zh: 法国显然已经战败了。

sentences.en: The entire British Expeditionary Force, 400,000 men are trapped in this pocket against the Channel.
sentences.zh: 整支英国远征军，40万名士兵被困在紧邻英吉利海峡的这个包围圈里。

sentences.en: The Panzers are closing in on the Channel ports of Boulogne, Calais and Dunkirk.
sentences.zh: 装甲部队正向布洛涅、加来和敦刻尔克的海峡港口步步逼近。

sentences.en: Surely, within days, Hitler's tanks will finish the job and then Britain will be forced to sue for peace.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，几天之内，希特勒的坦克就会完成任务，然后英国将被迫求和。

sentences.en: Or, Dominic, will Britain be forced to sue for peace?
sentences.zh: 还是说，多米尼克，英国真的会被迫求和吗？
